directive: One-word canon Titan names with updated unique mechanics tied to solo gameplay, role payoff, faction terrain, and counterplay.

titans.name: Atenra
titans.uniqueMechanic: Atenra's Solar Edict: a solo mechanic where Solar Charge grows through Aten-lit judgment ground, reaction-window mastery, and defender decisions that anchor a control zone and convert enemy commitment into mitigation. Payoff: hold objectives longer while redirecting the next revealed enemy intent. Counterplay: spread attackers, displacement, or terrain denial break the anchor; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
titans.preferredBattlefield: long survival, objective holding, hazard endurance
counterplay: attack from multiple timings instead of one burst
titans.gearIdentity: Titan-specific Aten Ra gear modifies Defender Solar Edict decisions rather than sharing generic stat sticks.
titans.collectionReason: Brings long survival, objective holding, hazard endurance through Atenra's Solar Edict without making the player's main Titan obsolete.
titans.notMandatoryRule: Recommended for certain problems, never required as an entry lock.
